ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community District; C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial District; and RS-3, Residential
Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
14-G and 16-G in the area bound by:

      South Ada Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West 63 rd Street; the alley next
      east of and parallel to South Ada Street; a line 94.6 north of and parallel to West 63 rd
      Street; South Throop Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West 63 rd Street;
      South Morgan Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West 63 rd Street; the
      northwest right-of-way line of West 63rd Parkway if extended southwest where no street
      exists; South Sangamon Street; and the alley next south of and parallel to West 63 rd
      Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            ____________________________
                                                            Stephanie D. Coleman
                                                            Alderman, 16h Ward




Common Address:
935-1323 W. 63rd Street
946-1322 W. 63rd Street
6249 S. Sangamon Avenue
